items.label: Version
items.warn: Changing this might have unintended consequences.

items.label: Drives
items.description: Root mount directories mapped to %D[n]% macros.

items.label: Insert Commercials
items.description: Enables automatic insertion of commercials and bumpers.

items.label: Max Play Attempts
items.description: Consecutive playback retry attempts before failure.

items.label: Commercials Per Break
items.description: Target boundary fill ('auto') or fixed spot count.

items.label: Commercials Delay Modifier
items.description: Real world delay multiplier for media transition overhead (0.5s default).

items.label: Commercials Fill Time Multiplier
items.description: Timeout multiplier during dynamic break assembly.

items.label: Commercials Offset Time
items.description: Seconds added or subtracted from fill duration for boundary alignment.

items.label: Time Test
items.description: Overrides system wall clock for testing (null for live operations).

items.label: Debug
items.description: Enables verbose messages in terminal and rapid schedule testing.

items.label: Debug Position
items.description: Max seconds a video or ad plays before skipping ahead in debug mode.

items.label: Report Data
items.description: Enables logging errors, playbacks, and status back to server.

items.label: Daily Reboot
items.description: Reboots system between 2:00 AM and 4:00 AM once uptime exceeds 5.7 hours.

items.label: Random Video On First Play
items.description: Ordered shows pick a random start episode on their first run.

items.label: Player Settings
items.description: Command-line arguments passed directly to the media player.

items.label: Plugins Directory
items.description: Path to external Python plugin scripts.

items.label: Cache Path
items.description: Directory used to store disk scan directory caches.
